hub_status_all.description: Shows the status of all registered agents (Hermes CIO, Clones, PI agents) in the communication hub. Returns online/offline status, heartbeat times, and agent types.

hub_sync_plane.description: Synchronizes with Plane (project management on localhost:8080). Auto-authenticates and returns workspaces, projects, and issues. Optional: workspace_slug and project_id for targeted queries.

hub_register_agent.description: Registers a new agent (Hermes Clone, PI agent, etc.) in the communication hub. Required before heartbeats can be sent.

hub_heartbeat.description: Sends a heartbeat for a registered agent. Keeps the status at 'online'. Should be called every 60-120 seconds.

hub_unregister_agent.description: Removes an agent from the registry.

hub_dashboard_url.description: Returns the URL of the status dashboard, if it is running.

params.workspace_slug: Plane workspace slug (e.g. 'me4'). Leave empty for all.
params.project_id: Plane project ID for issue queries. Leave empty for overview.
params.agent_id_heartbeat: ID of the agent sending the heartbeat.
params.agent_id_unregister: ID of the agent to remove.
